goal: Playable original adult Goddess Cathedral prototype in Godot 4; Lum first, then Urd, Belldandy, Skuld.
designLaw: Character roles, silhouettes, palette, costume and motions are sourced dynamically from canonical game/canon/CHARACTER_CANON_V1.json. This file is not a replacement character sheet.
identityLaw: Original fictional identities only; no celebrity likeness or real-person cloning. Banner art and illustrative search results cannot supersede game canon.
adultLaw: All characters are adults; Skuld is explicitly at least 25.
firstPlayableAcceptance: Lum walks into Cathedral, turns toward camera, delivers one dialogue line and responds to tap/mouse input. Demonstrate in actual Godot run.

progressiveIntegration.lum: Existing rig candidate; verify provenance, skeleton, import, animations and runtime before promotion.
progressiveIntegration.urd: Distinct tech-goth weave/time mother; asset candidate and runtime proof pending.
progressiveIntegration.belldandy: Distinct black/ivory/oxblood cathedral grace and healing; asset candidate and runtime proof pending.
progressiveIntegration.skuld: Adult engineering character with couture-tech styling and repair/tool motion; asset candidate and runtime proof pending.

assetPolicy: Use original GLB approved for runtime or visibly labeled procedural placeholders. Source slots and artwork concepts do not prove four 3D models exist.
releaseLaw: No automatic external publication, signing, source-truth supersession or runtime GREEN from source-only audits.
sourceLaw: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI proves. Human promotes.
